name: Wyandotte County, KS
findings: Wyandotte County has 539 nonprofit organizations. 223 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 163 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wyandotte County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Wyandotte County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 107 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
